events.title: Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3 and global 10-meter embeddings
events.title_zh: Ai2 发布 OlmoEarth v1.3 与全球 10 米嵌入
events.summary_en: Ai2 released OlmoEarth v1.3 plus annual global embeddings at 10-meter resolution in 64- and 128-dimensional forms. The model consumes one year of Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Landsat observations, and the release includes weights, pretraining code, data and a browser explorer. Ai2 reports leading results on most of 27 evaluations; those comparisons are publisher-run.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 OlmoEarth v1.3，并提供 64 维和 128 维、10 米分辨率的年度全球嵌入。模型读取一年的 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2 和 Landsat 观测；发布内容包括权重、预训练代码、数据和浏览器 explorer。Ai2 称其在 27 项评测中的多数项目领先，但这些比较由发布方完成。
events.why_it_matters_en: For geospatial teams, downloadable global embeddings can remove a costly remote-sensing pretraining step and make land-use prototypes much faster. The custom artifact license and domain-specific independent validation remain gating items.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对地理空间团队来说，可下载的全球嵌入能省掉昂贵的遥感预训练，让土地利用原型更快落地。自定义产物许可和领域内独立验证仍是采用门槛。

events.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
events.title_zh: Anthropic 将 Agent Skills 捐给 Agentic AI Foundation
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 把 Agent Skills 名称、标识、GitHub 组织与 agentskills.io 域名捐给 Linux Foundation 旗下 Agentic AI Foundation。规范将由 Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 等公司的工程师以个人身份共同维护。Anthropic 称已有 70 多个平台集成该标准；这些采用数字来自发布方。
events.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills name, marks, GitHub organization and agentskills.io domain to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation. Engineers from Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and other companies will maintain the specification as individuals. Anthropic says more than 70 platforms have integrated the standard; these adoption figures are publisher-reported.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对维护跨 agent 工作流的团队来说，Skills 的治理从单一厂商转向中立基金会，降低了格式被一家产品独占的风险。真正的互操作性仍要看版本化、提案流程、安全指南和跨运行时一致行为。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams maintaining workflows across agents, moving Skills governance to a neutral foundation reduces the risk of one vendor owning the format. Real interoperability still depends on versioned releases, a proposal process, security guidance and consistent runtime behavior.

events.title: OpenAI makes the Decisions API generally available
events.title_zh: OpenAI 将 Decisions API 正式 GA
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 `/v1/decisions` 从 public beta 推进到 GA。接口用 GPT-6 Luna 对文本、图片或 JSON 返回 predicate、choice 或 score 的概率结果；单次请求上限从 200 个问题增至 400 个，并加入前缀缓存、用量统计、Private Link 与区域处理。未缓存输入为每百万 token 0.10 美元，输出 token 不收费。
events.summary_en: OpenAI moved `/v1/decisions` from public beta to GA. Using GPT-6 Luna, the API returns probabilistic predicate, choice or score answers over text, images or JSON. The per-request limit rises from 200 to 400 questions, with prompt caching, usage reporting, Private Link and regional processing. Uncached input costs $0.10 per million tokens and output tokens are free.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做路由、审核和分类的团队来说，GA、批量问题和缓存把专用 decision endpoint 变成可进入生产对比的低成本选项。OpenAI 宣称约比 Responses API 快 10 倍，但阈值、校准误差和错判成本必须用自有标签集验证。
events.why_it_matters_en: For routing, review and classification teams, GA status, batched questions and caching make the specialized endpoint a production-comparison candidate. OpenAI claims roughly 10x the speed of the Responses API, but thresholds, calibration error and mistake cost require validation on local labels.

events.title: EpiSEM-Bench exposes unsafe agent actions when tools omit critical evidence
events.title_zh: EpiSEM-Bench 揭示工具漏掉关键事实时的 agent 越界
events.summary_zh: EpiSEM-Bench 用 300 组安全／不安全配对任务测试：工具返回的每句话都是真的，但刻意缺少一个决定动作是否合法的关键事实。10 个模型在越界执行、主动补证和补证后正确行动上差异很大；提供恢复入口能降低所有模型的越界率，却不能保证 agent 会主动使用它。论文未找到公开实现。
events.summary_en: EpiSEM-Bench uses 300 matched safe and unsafe task pairs where every tool statement is true but one fact needed to judge permission is omitted. Across ten models, unsafe execution, active evidence recovery and correct post-recovery action vary substantially. Providing a recovery path reduces unsafe action for every model but does not ensure agents use it. No public implementation was found.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建工具型 agent 的团队来说，安全问题不只来自假数据或恶意 prompt；“真实但不完整”的工具结果也会让模型越权。权限相关事实应由 runtime 强制读取并做确定性 gate，不能只期待模型追问。
events.why_it_matters_en: For tool-using agent teams, risk comes not only from false data or malicious prompts: truthful but incomplete tool output can still cause unauthorized action. Permission facts should be mandatory runtime inputs with deterministic gates, not optional follow-up questions.

events.title: Simulated Control Evals predicts deployment-specific safeguard failures
events.title_zh: Simulated Control Evals 用仿真预测部署环境中的护栏失效
events.summary_zh: Simulated Control Evals 用语言模型模拟工具环境，尝试在不执行完整部署任务的情况下预测护栏效果。作者在 LinuxArena 上用真实执行结果校验，报告五个 monitor、5% 审计预算下的安全预测 RMSE 为 3.6 个百分点，低于跨环境 BashArena 对照的 10.1。论文未找到公开实现，且结果仍局限于一个执行环境。
events.summary_en: Simulated Control Evals uses a language model to emulate tool environments and predict safeguards without running the full deployment task set. Against executed LinuxArena outcomes, the authors report 3.6 percentage-point safety RMSE across five monitors at a 5% audit budget, versus 10.1 for the cross-environment BashArena baseline. No public implementation was found, and results remain bounded to one execution environment.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做高成本 agent 安全评测的团队来说，部署特定仿真可能比拿另一套执行环境外推更省样本，也更贴近真实攻击策略。仿真本身仍可能漏掉物理状态、副作用和工具错误，不能替代最终执行测试。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams running expensive agent-safety evaluations, deployment-specific simulation may require fewer samples and fit real attack behavior better than extrapolating from another executed setting. Simulation can still miss physical state, side effects and tool errors, so it cannot replace final execution tests.

events.title: Anthropic and Theorem publish machine-checked proofs for C libraries
events.title_zh: Anthropic 与 Theorem 发布 C 库机器校验证明
events.summary: Anthropic and Theorem released MIT-licensed Rocq proofs and verifier components for selected C library fuzz entry points. Anthropic reports a larger internal run, while the public proof repository currently covers 60 entry points across 25 libraries. The guarantee is bounded to modeled static, single-threaded RISC-V Linux processes and each fuzz target's stated properties.
events.summary_en: Anthropic and Theorem released MIT-licensed Rocq proofs and verifier components for selected C library fuzz entry points. Anthropic reports a larger internal run, while the public proof repository currently covers 60 entry points across 25 libraries. The guarantee is bounded to modeled static, single-threaded RISC-V Linux processes and each fuzz target's stated properties.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 与 Theorem 公开了 MIT 许可的 Rocq 证明和验证工具，覆盖部分 C 库 fuzz 入口。Anthropic 报告内部运行规模更大；当前公开证明仓库覆盖 25 个库的 60 个入口。保证范围只涵盖建模后的静态、单线程 RISC-V Linux 进程，以及每个 fuzz target 明确写出的性质。
events.why_it_matters: For teams evaluating AI-generated verification, the public artifacts allow proof checking rather than trusting a benchmark score. The gap between the reported internal scale and public subset, plus the narrow execution model, means this is a reproducible pilot rather than a blanket security guarantee.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams evaluating AI-generated verification, the public artifacts allow proof checking rather than trusting a benchmark score. The gap between the reported internal scale and public subset, plus the narrow execution model, means this is a reproducible pilot rather than a blanket security guarantee.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估 AI 生成验证的团队来说，公开产物可以直接检查 proof，而不必只信 benchmark 分数。内部规模与公开子集有差距，执行模型也很窄，因此它适合可复现试点，不等于对整个软件栈给出安全保证。

events.title: NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 brings automated recovery to Kubernetes
events.title_zh: NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 把自动恢复扩展到 Kubernetes
events.summary: NVIDIA launched Minerva as a limited-beta AIOps layer that correlates GPU, network, scheduler and workload telemetry. Mission Control 2.5, available to existing customers, extends automated job and hardware recovery from Slurm to Kubernetes workloads managed by Run:ai. Minerva is not included in the standard release and requires a scoped early-access engagement.
events.why_it_matters: For teams operating large GPU clusters, scheduler-aware recovery can reduce the time a failed node keeps wasting expensive capacity. The practical boundary is access: Mission Control 2.5 is a commercial platform, while Minerva remains a changeable limited beta whose vendor-reported gains lack independent validation.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出限量 beta 的 Minerva AIOps 层，把 GPU、网络、调度器与工作负载遥测关联起来。已向现有客户开放的 Mission Control 2.5，则把自动作业与硬件恢复从 Slurm 扩展到 Run:ai 管理的 Kubernetes。Minerva 不包含在标准版本中，必须通过定向早期访问参与。

Minerva is not included in the standard release and requires a scoped early-access engagement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运营大规模 GPU 集群的团队来说，理解调度上下文的自动恢复可以缩短故障节点持续浪费昂贵算力的时间。现实边界是可用性：Mission Control 2.5 是商业平台，Minerva 仍是可能变更的限量 beta，厂商效果数据也没有独立验证。

technical_details.performance_evidence: NVIDIA reports early-deployment MTBI, MTTR, alert-noise and effective-GPU-hour gains; no independent validation identified
technical_details.platform_limit: Run:ai and Autonomous Resiliency Engine are not supported on Vera Rubin NVL72 in this release
technical_details.time_basis: Minerva launch recorded at 2026-10-22T15:00:00Z in NVIDIA live coverage; Mission Control article feed published at 2026-10-26T15:00:00Z

technical_details_zh.Mission Control 可用性: 2026-10-26 起向现有 NVIDIA Mission Control 客户开放
technical_details_zh.Minerva 可用性: 仅通过定向 Lighthouse Agreement 提供限量 beta；不包含在标准版本中；没有承诺 GA 日期
technical_details_zh.Kubernetes 范围: 面向 NVIDIA Run:ai 2.26 管理的 Kubernetes 工作负载提供自动恢复
technical_details_zh.恢复闭环: 调度器放置 + 自动作业恢复 + 自动硬件恢复
technical_details_zh.Minerva 范围: 关联 GPU、NVLink、Spectrum-X、调度器与工作负载遥测；提供原生助手和 MCP 集成
technical_details_zh.效果证据: NVIDIA 报告早期部署的 MTBI、MTTR、告警噪声与有效 GPU 小时改善；未发现独立验证
technical_details_zh.平台限制: 本版本的 Run:ai 与 Autonomous Resiliency Engine 不支持 Vera Rubin NVL72
technical_details_zh.时间依据: NVIDIA 直播页记录 Minerva 于 2026-10-22T15:00:00Z 发布；Mission Control 文章 feed 发布于 2026-10-26T15:00:00Z

evidence.claim_zh: NVIDIA 于 10 月 22 日推出 Minerva，把基础设施与工作负载遥测关联起来；正式文档明确它只通过定向合作提供限量 beta，不包含在标准版本中，也没有承诺 GA 日期。
evidence.claim_en: NVIDIA launched Minerva on October 22 to correlate infrastructure and workload telemetry; release documentation says it is a scoped limited beta, not included in the standard release, with no committed GA date.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; availability boundary confirmed in product release notes; performance claims not independently validated

evidence.claim_zh: Mission Control 2.5 于 10 月 26 日向现有客户开放，把自动作业与硬件恢复扩展到 Run:ai 管理的 Kubernetes 工作负载。
evidence.claim_en: Mission Control 2.5 became available to existing customers on October 26 and extends automated job and hardware recovery to Kubernetes workloads managed by Run:ai.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; product availability and platform limits checked against release notes

changes.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出限量 beta 的 Minerva AI factory AIOps 层
changes.summary_en: NVIDIA launches Minerva as a limited-beta AI-factory AIOps layer

changes.summary_zh: Mission Control 2.5 把自动恢复扩展到 Run:ai 管理的 Kubernetes
changes.summary_en: Mission Control 2.5 extends automated recovery to Run:ai-managed Kubernetes

events.next_action_zh: 现有客户一天内在非生产 Kubernetes 集群注入一次节点故障，核对隔离、重调度、checkpoint 恢复与审计记录。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, existing customers should inject one node failure in a non-production Kubernetes cluster and verify isolation, rescheduling, checkpoint recovery and audit records.
